---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new tool, agent, provider, or workflow
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

> **Before you file:** for non-trivial features, please open a
> [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/forest/forgewright/discussions/new?category=ideas)
> first. We use discussions to align on the approach before opening a
> tracking issue, and we'd rather co-design a feature than rework a
> 2,000-line PR.

## Summary

<!-- One sentence: the feature, in user terms ("as a developer running
     forgewright on a Pi, I want …"). -->

## Use case

<!-- What real workflow does this unblock? Who benefits, and how often?
     Be specific. "It would be nice to have" is not a use case. -->

## Proposed solution

<!--
  Sketch the user-facing change. A few bullets are fine; a design
  document is not required. If the change touches the public API,
  show the before/after signature.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
  What else did you consider, and why is this approach better? If you
  considered a plugin / hook / MCP server / fork, say so.
-->

## Out of scope for v0.1

<!--
  Some things we explicitly do not want to add in v0.1 — see
  CONTRIBUTING.md § "A note on scope". If your feature falls into one
  of these, explain why we should make an exception, or scope it down
  to something that doesn't.
-->

## Willing to send a PR?

<!--
  If yes, link the design discussion you opened first. If no, that's
  fine — we may pick it up, or it may get parked.
-->

- [ ] Yes — I've opened a discussion and would like to drive this.
- [ ] No — happy to review, but not the right person to implement it.
- [ ] Maybe — depends on scope after discussion.

## Additional context

<!-- Links, screenshots, prior art in other agent frameworks, etc. -->
